measures.text:
1. NORTH AMERICAN ICE SERVICE (NAIS)
   ICEBERG BULLETIN 230001Z NOV.
2. ICEBERG LIMIT ALONG TRACKLINE JOINING
   50-45N 056-05W, 50-15N 054-15W,
   50-45N 053-00W, 53-45N 051-00W,
   60-00N 058-00W.
3. ESTIMATED ICEBERG LIMIT ALONG
   TRACKLINE JOINING
   60-00N 058-00W, 61-00N 054-35W,
   58-40N 043-55W, 59-35N 040-00W,
   64-25N 036-50W, 65-00N 028-00W.
4. WESTERN ICEBERG LIMIT ALONG TRACKLINE
   JOINING
   51-49N 056-10W, 51-32N 056-05W.
5. SEA ICE LIMIT ALONG TRACKLINES
   JOINING:
   A. 59-36N 065-27W, 58-54N 067-33W,
      59-28N 069-09W, 61-06N 069-01W,
      62-46N 074-03W, 62-46N 075-42W,
      64-12N 079-36W, 63-46N 074-12W,
      62-30N 070-45W, 61-52N 066-17W.
   B. 61-59N 066-00W, 62-12N 064-09W,
      67-00N 059-58W, 69-54N 061-36W,
      70-09N 061-07W.
6. MOST RECENT RECONNAISSANCE:
   EASTERN LIMIT SATELLITE PASS 22 NOV 26.
7. REPORT POSITION AND TIME OF ANY ICEBERGS
   SEA ICE OR STATIONARY RADAR TARGETS THAT
   MAY LIKELY BE ICE TO THE NEAREST CANADIAN
   COAST GUARD MARINE COMMUNICATIONS AND
   TRAFFIC SERVICE STATION OR
   USING INMARSAT CODE 42.
8. FOR MORE REPORTING INFORMATION OR TO
   DOWNLOAD SHAPEFILES AND WEEKLY PREDICTIONS,
   GO TO WWW.NAVCEN.USCG.GOV/INTERNATIONAL-ICE-PATROL.
9. CANCEL THIS MSG 240001Z NOV 26.
